purpose: Dependency audit for every combat-training method currently surfaced by the planner. Adds target classification, important support unlocks, and cross-region synergies without pretending optional support gear is mandatory.

policy.support_rule: recommended_unlocks are high-impact support items or passives, not hard requirements unless the base method says otherwise.
policy.region_rule: supporting_regions identifies regions that materially improve a method located elsewhere. It must not overwrite the method's actual location region.
policy.salve_rule: Only mark Salve amulet synergy for monsters explicitly classed as undead. Ghouls and vyres are not Salve targets.

recommended_unlocks.name: Salve amulet (e)
recommended_unlocks.effect: +20% damage and +20% hit chance against the Lumbridge Catacombs skeletons

set.dependency_note: The training spot itself is Misthalin. Morytania materially improves the skeleton method through the enchanted Salve amulet, so this is a useful cross-region synergy rather than a hard two-region gate.
The method's meaningful regional dependency is the Forinthry/Wilderness Abyss entrance. No Salve synergy is assigned.

recommended_unlocks.name: Blood essence
recommended_unlocks.effect: Equipping a blood essence makes all ravenous ghouls in the crypt aggressive

set.dependency_note: Ravenous ghouls are not undead. Do not recommend Salve amulet or Salve amulet (e) here.

recommended_unlocks.name: Sunspear
recommended_unlocks.effect: +75% hit chance against vyres, a chance to deal up to double normal attack damage, and automatic Prayer/Firemaking XP from cremations

recommended_unlocks.name: 500-vyre corpse cremation progression
recommended_unlocks.effect: Every 50 manually cremated vyre corpses adds +10 damage to blisterwood/Sunspear against vyres, up to +100

recommended_unlocks.name: Morytania elite achievements
recommended_unlocks.effect: +50% Prayer and Firemaking XP from cremating vyre corpses, including Sunspear cremations

set.dependency_note: Vyres use the Ivandis/blisterwood/Sunspear progression, not the Salve amulet system.

recommended_unlocks.name: Salve amulet (e)
recommended_unlocks.effect: +20% damage and +20% hit chance against bound skeletons

set.dependency_note: Under the current Fort working map this is a Misthalin method with a strong optional Morytania support unlock.

recommended_unlocks.name: Demon horn necklace prayer-sustain chain
recommended_unlocks.effect: Daemonheim supplies the Demon horn necklace; pair with an Attuned ectoplasmator when using infernal-ash kills for prayer sustain

set.dependency_note: Abyssal savages are demons, not undead. Do not attach Salve bonuses to this row.

recommended_unlocks.name: Demon horn necklace + Attuned ectoplasmator
recommended_unlocks.effect: Current low-input setups use this prayer-sustain chain; the necklace is a Dungeoneering reward

recommended_unlocks.name: Player-owned Slayer Dungeon route
recommended_unlocks.effect: An optional Sunken Pyramid route becomes available after capturing abyssal beast souls; Wilderness remains the direct Forinthry option

alternate_region_routes.requirements: Captured abyssal beast souls and the Player-owned Slayer Dungeon setup

set.dependency_note: Forinthry is the direct Wilderness route. Desert is an optional self-contained Player-owned Slayer Dungeon route rather than a mandatory second region.

recommended_unlocks.name: Salve amulet (e)
recommended_unlocks.effect: +20% damage and +20% hit chance against armoured phantoms

set.dependency_note: The Fort crypt method is a current Misthalin working-map entry with a strong optional Morytania support dependency.
